subject: TEST RESULT: cached peer role reproduces 89.5 vs 0 tilt by iteration order
body: WORKSTREAM_ID=ws-performance-rd-panel-role-remap-coherence-20261002. LOCAL_VALIDATION=PASS. Reduced Python and independently compiled Kotlin models reproduce current semantics and exact DuoShader cover/concurrent formulas. Pre-remap A=inner,B=cover; post-remap A=cover,B=inner; hinge=150deg. Current cached-peer A->B gives A=89.5; B->A gives A=0.0. Fresh-peer-geometry policy gives A=0.0 in both orders. Kotlin model compiled with kotlinc and executed successfully. Python assertions passed. This proves order dependence and proves the minimal policy correction at the reduced logic level; it does not establish Fold7 incidence/frequency.
